thread:
Sam Rivera: Hey folks — quick payroll/policy check. My sibling passed and I need 8 days off across Dec 29-Jan 5 for travel and arrangements. I know year-end blackout blocks PTO Dec 27-31. Is bereavement treated differently?
Aisha (People Ops): Sam 

So sorry for your loss. Condolences. Bereavement is handled via the Bereavement Leave policy not regular PTO. For covered relationships we provide up to 15 days paid bereavement; these days do not count toward the year-end blackout. Please file the Bereavement Leave request in Workday and attach a short note.
Sam Rivera: Thank you. Good to know it's separate. Any paperwork needed for travel days (Jan 4-5) that fall outside immediate services window?
Lena (Payroll): Hi Sam 

Payroll will code up to 15 days as 'Bereavement Paid Leave' automatically once People Ops approves. If you need extra PTO beyond 15 days, that would be regular PTO and subject to blackout rules. For travel days past the paid window, you can request an advance PTO or unpaid leave.
Aisha (People Ops): Filing steps: 1) Manager approval in the thread (Sam, pls confirm manager). 2) Employee submits Bereavement request in Workday and uploads any supporting note if available. 3) People Ops approves and we notify Payroll.
Sam Rivera: Manager sign-off from Priya (CC'd). Priya approves.
Priya (Manager): Approved 

Take the time you need, Sam.
Nora (Legal): Quick flag 

If travel crosses borders, payroll might need to check tax/residency withholding implications for paid leave. People Ops, please loop Legal if the employee will be paid while working/absent in another country.
Sam Rivera: Thanks Nora, travel is domestic (within US).
HR-Bot: Created ticket HR-2026-1203 for Sam Rivera 

Attach Workday request link and manager approval when ready.
Aisha (People Ops): Policy excerpt: ```
Bereavement Leave: Up to 15 days of paid leave for immediate family bereavement. These days are not subject to year-end PTO blackout and do not reduce accrued PTO balance. Additional days may be taken as PTO (subject to blackout) or unpaid leave.```

Aisha (People Ops): Sam, once you submit in Workday reply here with the Workday request link and we'll process. Sending condolences again. :heart:
Sam Rivera: Filed the Workday request and attached flight receipts. Link: https://workday.redwood/req/BR-4321
HR-Bot: HR-2026-1203 updated — Workday link attached. People Ops assigned.
Lena (Payroll): Got it 

Well mark the Dec 29-31 and Jan 1-3 as Bereavement Paid Leave. Jan 4-5 are pending — Sam let us know if you want them as advance PTO or unpaid.
Sam Rivera: Please mark Jan 4-5 as advance PTO and Ill repay via payroll over next 2 months. Thanks everyone for the quick help. :pray:
